# Grand Piano sound

The Grand Piano voice uses recordings from **Salamander Grand Piano V3** by Alexander Holm, licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). The instrument is a Yamaha C5 grand piano.

CADENCE-1 uses 17 notes from velocity layer 9 of the [SFZ Instruments distribution](https://github.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano/tree/3382bf9496bba2486f5ab0de55a264d1dfc38404). The recordings were mixed to mono, trimmed and faded, resampled to 16 kHz, level matched, calibrated for pitch, and encoded as 8-bit mu-law for the FM-1. The compact bank is included in the firmware. The full license is in [CC-BY-3.0-Unported.txt](CC-BY-3.0-Unported.txt).
